FUL's website has a TETFund section covering Special Intervention (High Impact and Zonal) and Annual Intervention (Institution-Based Research, Physical Infrastructure/Program Upgrade, and the TETFund eLearning Project). The TETFund Unit is listed under the Office of the Vice-Chancellor.
FUL lists the FUL Zoo and Conservatory (FULZAC) under its Support Services. Check the official website page for current details.

FUL's website also has these sections: Giving/Donations, Enterprises, Photo Gallery, Featured Videos, Downloads, Staff Email, Staff Profile, and Market Days (market.fulokoja.edu.ng). Use the links on www.fulokoja.edu.ng.

Besides those already mentioned, FUL's Support Services list includes Council Affairs, Advancement and Linkages, Environmental Health, GST, Information and Protocol, Internal Audit, the TETFund Unit and the Registry (with Academic Affairs and Human Resources). Contact them through official FUL channels.

patterns: what is the latest news at ful
responses: Recent items on FUL's news pages include: the 10th Convocation rescheduled to Saturday, November 14, 2026 (from October 17), announced September 23; FUL unveiled a Five-Year Partnership Portfolio and called for strategic investment (September 25, 2026); a press release on Prof. Ibileye's 100 days in office as Vice-Chancellor; a VC address on the SUG election; and, in June 2026, a research partnership with NIMR and the start of the 2026/2027 admission screening. News changes often, so check www.fulokoja.edu.ng.
